## Progress

- [Isogeny.lean](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/FormalizedSources/AbelianVarieties/Milne/MilneLib/Isogeny.lean:772): added the proper finite-fibre isogeny criterion and routed the abelian-variety specialization through it. Commit `1a826869b0`.
- [Dimension.lean](/home/axel/LeanAlgebraicGeometry-Horizon/FormalizedSources/AbelianVarieties/Milne/MilneLib/Dimension.lean:252): added ring-equivalence, cotangent, Krull-dimension, regularity, and group-translation transport APIs. Commits `7ee369469f`, `1fdd8dd537`, and `e7c67d6285`.
- Checkpointed the running task and synchronized Milne graph in `1e8af34535` and `8bdc54f9fa`.
- `horizon check MilneLib` passes all 3163 jobs. Final LSP diagnostics are empty; theorem scans use only standard axioms, and `MilneLib` has no `sorry`, `admit`, or project axioms.
- Hgraph: 544 nodes / 245 edges, with the three historical I-2213 stale nodes retained. No blueprint source was changed.

## Issues

The frozen characterization still needs global proper dimension/projectivity, unconditional homomorphism flatness and geometric-fibre translation, and the generic coherent-stalk bridge. I-2157’s missing task-board anchors remain a human decision.

The shared ledger still has concurrent event/control-plane changes from other runs; Milne-owned paths are clean and those shared paths were intentionally not committed.

## Why I stopped

The standing objective is partly advanced, not complete. `fs-milne` remains running as requested. No build or proof failure remains; an intermediate syntax error was caught by LSP and corrected before commit.

## Next

Use translation transport in the uniform/global dimension argument, then continue the projectivity/flatness and coherent-stalk frontiers.
